abi_discriminator: ENG1 2c310 forwards two DWORDs. Static host table slot+0x4c points to native host_01bd0, which consumes five; with distinct A1..A5 the bounded original-wrapper fixture supplies A1,A2,outer-return,A1,A2. This falsifies the proposed static ABI composition, not actual runtime behavior.
limits: The synthetic native-instruction fixtures stop at provider entry; no original Windows host/module execution or live-table observation.
ENG3 tail-JMP slot+0x18 composes with the static empty callback only in that fixture; a tail jump cannot establish C arity/type.
Whole-owner storage proof and exact slot addresses do not identify the live callback ABI or table lifetime.
required_evidence: Identify the actual passed table, copy timing and any provider/slot mutations or aliases during the relevant engine invocations.
Establish each live provider ABI from its own native body and independent outside callers; resolve the two-versus-five conflict.
Only then consider a narrow fixed-slot CALL/JMP proof with wrong slot/base/transfer/ABI controls; no blanket BSS indirect-call exception.
conclusion: NO-GO for existing gate or family-wide acceptance: fixed-slot representation and independently justified runtime ABI/lifetime evidence are absent.
